description:
Implement load_data() method for PySparkSQLAdapter supporting
local and cloud data sources in CSV, Parquet, and TBL formats.

Unlike Databricks (cloud-only), PySpark SQL supports both local
file paths and cloud storage (S3, GCS, ABFS).

Data loading flow:
1. Read files into DataFrame (spark.read.csv/parquet)
2. Apply column names from schema
3. Write as managed Spark table (saveAsTable)
4. Verify row counts
